I was honored to be able to join the families of the fallen on the 25th anniversary of 9/11. To everyone who read names and recounted stories of their loved ones: thank you for your courage and for telling us a little about the person you lost. 

It was an amazing tribute to the 3,000 people murdered that day. May God rest their souls and give comfort to those they left behind.

All of us have our own rituals to remember that day. I always read this story, and I share it in the hopes you find it
